simple.meaning: חָדִיד (Châdîyd) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chadid , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָדִיד (H2307) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:33, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
